He wrote the date in the margin, trimmed the wick, and watched the beam sweep the water, thinking about nails.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一台刚停下的机器，还带着余温。路灯把空无一人的马路照成一条发白的河，红绿灯仍在认真地换色，没人需要它。环卫车的刷子擦过石板，水痕一圈圈地退。早点铺的卷帘门升到一半，蒸笼先于人醒来，白气爬上玻璃。送奶的三轮车吱呀拐进巷口，狗叫了一声又睡回去。写字楼里剩下三两格亮窗，不知是谁在赶一份谁都不会细看的报表。天还没亮，天边那层灰已经比屋顶浅了一点，鸟先知道。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to do most of the work — like standing in a long line and asking the person ahead of you \"how many people are in front of you?\" instead of counting everyone yourself.\n• Every recursive thing needs a stopping point, called the base case: the person at the very front answers \"zero\" without asking anyone, and then the answers travel back down the line, each person adding one.\n• You already know a recursive thing: open a box, and if there's a smaller box inside, open that one too, and keep going until you find a box with no box inside it."}
